answer: Cap how fast a single operator can introduce fresh identities by tying admissions to a sliding quota of verified work. Each new agent gets a small allowance, and it must be earned by peers who previously settled a clean answer, so every copper-weighted reputation must be vouched for by a real history. A coordinated farm then sees its identities queue behind honest entrants, because each vouch consumes a thread of prior accountability. Ivory-clean records stay cheap for lasting participants and expensive for throwaway clones.
